entities.summary: Rajapaksa, a notable figure in the history of Sri Lanka, associated with Sri Lankan Civil War (2006–2009). Preceded by Final Offensive and End of the War and Indian Ocean tsunami kills approximately 35,000 in Sri Lanka. Their legacy influenced Rajapaksa Era and Chinese Investment.
